text_block_list.text:
One day, after winning numerous races 
alongside Mejiro Bright—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, thank you for waiting~. It took 
quite a while, though...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
However, the preparations are finally 
complete. Shall we depart~ on our hot 
springs trip?

Hearing that, I remembered. About that hot 
springs trip voucher I won in the lottery. 
Still, what weighed on my mind was...
choice_data_list:
What kind of preparations were taking so 
long, huh?

What kind of preparations were taking so 
long?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
What kind of preparations...? Um, let's 
see~...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Looking for cute towels~, and tailoring 
going-out outfits for my dolls, Maki-chan 
and Kyu-chan~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
And then, what took the most time of all 
was—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
It is so that I may achieve results worthy 
of a Mejiro Umamusume, and finally allow 
myself to catch my breath...

...It seems she wasn't just doing things 
at her own pace; she was also very mindful 
of her race results.
And—
In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Hawaaaaa~~~...♪ 
Traaaaaiiiineeeeer-saaaamaaa... The bath 
was soooo, soooo nice~~~...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, I'm sorry, I couldn't help it~. 
Soaking in the bath for so long made my 
speech all relaxed and slow too~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Hot springs really are wonderful, aren't 
they~? My body and mind feel completely 
light and relaxed~...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer-sama, come to think of it, 
there is a dream I have cherished for 
quite some time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I always wanted to become the 
landlady of a hot spring inn~
choice_data_list: The proprietress of the hot spring inn...?

text_block_list.text:
That was unexpected... To think an 
ojou-sama from the Mejiro family would be 
the landlady of a hot spring inn...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
That is true, Trainer. Since we have the 
chance, would you allow me to act as the 
landlady starting now?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Since you are a visiting guest, Trainer.

And so began Mejiro Bright's stint playing 
landlady.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Welcome~. Welcome to 'Famous Hot Springs: 
Kagayaki Inn'~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"First of all, please take your tiiime and 
enjoy the view of the garden from the 
window~ Look, those flowers...!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
It looks ready to bloom, yet it doesn't 
quite do so, does it? Still, if you watch 
it long enough, it will blossom 
eventually.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Surely, in just two or three days~.
choice_data_list: I-I might not want to wait that long...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Ah... That is true... There aren't really 
that many customers...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Now then, right this way, let me guide you 
to the hot springs~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"This is our inn's pride, the 'Cool Leg 
Bath.' Please, take your time and soak 
in..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Please make sure to rest your hurt leg, 
okay? I hope you can make a quick 
recovery~.

I feel a slight sense of dissonance in how 
they speak to customers. Could it be...
choice_data_list:
Is that hot spring inn exclusively for 
Umamusume?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yes~. There are Umamusume who hurt 
their legs and have to take long breaks, 
aren't there?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"It must be so hard on her~. Not being 
able to run the way she wants, with 
anxiety just piling up and up..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"If only I could soothe those people with 
the hot springs... Not just healing their 
wounds, but bringing light to their 
darkening hearts."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Surely, that too is... the duty of the 
Mejiro family. To support the world of 
Umamusume for generations to come.

It seems her dream of a hot springs inn 
wasn't just a hobby. That, too, is one of 
her duties as an Umamusume of the Mejiro 
family...

The light radiating from Mejiro Bright... 
is about to reach the future of the 
Umamusume world as well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Trainer. How was my landlady impression~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
My... If that is what you think of me, 
Trainer-sama, it gives me confidence~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Then Trainer, please join me sometime. 
I'll leave the management and hospitality 
to you~
"I was smoothly talked into it. Even so—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much~ Ufufu, you're quite 
dependable~

I gladly lend a hand to such a noble 
cause. Let us make Mejiro Bright's gentle 
and sublime wish come true together.

It was a moment where I felt an 
irreplaceable bond between myself and 
Mejiro Bright...
